title: Public docs show an internal ticket ID in --kanbus-issue-id examples
description:
**Problem**
The public documentation examples pass an internal ticket ID to `--kanbus-issue-id`, leaking an internal board reference into customer-facing docs.

**Evidence**
- dashboard/app/documentation/concepts/evaluations/page.tsx:224
- dashboard/app/documentation/methods/evaluate-score/page.tsx:350 and :359

**Fix**
Replace with an obvious placeholder such as `<issue-id>`.

**How to verify**
`git grep -n 'kanbus-issue-id plx-' -- dashboard` returns nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
